race.comment: HAZARDOUS (10) made the right start at Wodonga, winning a Mdn over 1100m by two lengths as favourite after settling midfield and finishing strongly. She is new to 900m, but the debut win, barrier two and 2kg claim give her a clear platform to remain unbeaten. OPETAIA (6) resumes from a five-month break and her Queensland form reads well for this grade, even though she was unwanted and well held at Doomben before the spell. She looks a genuine fresh danger. TESORO MIO (2) also resumes and brings solid BM62 lines from last campaign, including a Cranbourne second on heavy ground before things went wrong at Swan Hill. Blinkers come off and her only start at the distance was a win. FOURTHTIMELUCKY (1) can feature in the finish on resumption.
